capabilities: Copy editor selections or heading sections as Markdown, plain text, or formatted HTML
Export selections and headings as PDF, Markdown, TXT, or HTML files
Copy rendered tables as Markdown, HTML, CSV, or TSV via an action button
Open the copy/export modal from Outline rows via an optional experimental integration
extras: Much of the README is developer-oriented (build, test, and git workflow). The Outline integration relies on Obsidian's private DOM and may break after updates; PDF pages are rendered as images, so PDF text is not selectable, and remote images may be missing from PDFs. Includes donation links.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in unified way to copy or export selected text, whole heading sections, rendered tables, or images to other formats and apps.

relations.evidence: PDF and HTML conversion use marked, DOMPurify, html2canvas, and pdf-lib.

summary: Copy and export toolkit that copies or exports selections, headings, tables, and images as Markdown, plain text, formatted HTML, PDF, CSV, or TSV.
